headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 30, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a thrilling 8-6 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, led by Griffin Conine's home run and two RBIs. The Arizona Diamondbacks shut out the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-0, with Eduardo Rodriguez pitching 8.0 innings of shutout baseball. The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Washington Nationals 5-2, with Kazuma Okamoto contributing 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. The Texas Rangers placed Jakob Junis on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain. The Rangers also transferred Jose Corniell to the 60-day injured list and Danny Jansen to the 60-day injured list. The Minnesota Twins placed Byron Buxton on the 10-day injured list with a right hip impingement. The Tampa Bay Rays placed Cole Sulser on the 15-day injured list due to lower back spasms.

Several teams made notable roster moves. The Detroit Tigers traded C Jake Rogers to the Baltimore Orioles for RHP Zane Barnhart. The Los Angeles Angels traded C Logan O'Hoppe and RHP Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers for SS Angel Arredondo. The Baltimore Orioles traded RF Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash. The San Diego Padres signed SS Nu'u Contrades.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, ultimately emerging victorious with a final score of 8-6. Griffin Conine led the Marlins' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eduardo Rodriguez leading the way on the mound. Rodriguez pitched 8.0 innings, allowing 0 earned runs and striking out 2 batters.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Nationals 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-2 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Kazuma Okamoto leading the offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs. Trey Yesavage earned the win with 6.2 innings pitched, striking out 4 and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Tigers in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a hard-fought 10-9 win over the Detroit Tigers, coming out on top in a high-scoring matchup. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Rangers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, snapping a close contest in the final innings. Impact hitters for the Rays included Yandy Díaz and Cedric Mullins, while Jonny DeLuca also made a notable contribution for the Rangers.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins edged out the Kansas City Royals 4-3 in a close game. Impact players for the Twins included John Rave and Cole Sands, while Noah Cameron stood out on the mound.

top_news.title: **Rangers RHP Junis Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Jakob Junis has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain, effective retroactive to July 29, 2026. The Texas Rangers right-hander will miss at least two weeks of action.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire RHP Zane Barnhart in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers made a move on July 30, 2026, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zane Barnhart from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for catcher Jake Rogers.
